blocks.text: The multi-awarded Filipino family drama “Apol of My Ai,” directed by Thop Nazareno, will open in cinemas nationwide on Dec. 2 following its successful run at the 2026 CinePanalo Film Festival. The film won four awards at the festival, including the Special Jury Prize, Best Supporting Actor for Zanjoe Marudo, Best Child Performer for Zion Cruz, and Best Musical Score for Emerzon Texon. It also received eight nominations, including Best Film, Best Director, Best Screenplay, Best Cinematography, Best Editing, Best Production Design, Best Sound Design, and Best Supporting Actress for Rochelle Pangilinan. “Apol of My Ai” follows Apolinario “Apol” Medina Jr. […]...
